name: manhunt-irl
description: Mobile-first real-life Manhunt game with synchronized hunter wheel, geofenced boundary, live 360 video pings, and GPS ping mode.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
